title: Hiring artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Lagi nyari tempat buat berkembang di industri komik & ilustrasi? Mungkin ini yang kamu cari. OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Kami mencari yang serius, konsisten, dan bisa kerja bareng tim. Kirim CV & Portofolio ke: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subjek: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Dibuka sampai semua posisi terisi.

author: attenboroughac
title: Open call: floral mural painter for exhibition
content: Open Call: Painting a mural for an exhibition at Attenborough Arts Centre. Jemisha Maadhavji is looking for artist/s to paint a floral wallpaper mural on one 10m wall. Open to all including students and recent graduates. Painter should follow reference images of floral patterns and leaves, be comfortable using acrylic paints, adapt to exhibition requirements, and complete the mural in the given time frame. Commission fee £750. Materials will be provided. Duration of job - 3 days: start date 28th September 2026 to 30th September 2026. Location Attenborough Arts Centre, Leicester. Please send a short bio also explaining why you are suitable for this job, portfolio and examples of your work or submit your website and Instagram to jemishamaadhavji7@gmail.com and Cc mybc1@leicester.ac.uk by 21st September 2026.
